name: smwgraphics-alpha-test-area
title: Alpha Test Area
description:
This tileset has many vibrant colors for their respective objects, also containing items from other Mario games, such as Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels, Super Mario Bros. 3, Super Mario Maker, etc.

It also contains 2 Background variants plus the default one, resulting in three options.

You can also use these blocks for the directional spikes, and the Screen Scrolling Pipes for the pipes, but they are optional.

Ripped from this sheet, made by SuperSledgeBro.

Enjoy!
